mobbin:06bcb061-a16d-4a6f-95bd-8c5e31c5f.summary: In a live huddle, the user turns on push-to-talk from 'More options' and then talks by holding down a large button instead of using the normal mute.
steps: Push-to-talk on, microphone muted, X to exit
Large green microphone button, ready to hold
Button held down; rings show it is live
steal: Push-to-talk is a mode you switch on during a session (screen 1), not a permanent replacement for mute.
While push-to-talk is on, a crossed-out microphone, a 'Push-to-talk' label and an X to exit make it clear you are not live yet (screen 2).
A large button at the bottom of the screen lets the user talk without looking for a tiny icon (screens 3 to 4).
Rings pulse around the microphone button while it is held, so the user knows the channel is open (screen 4).
avoid: Push-to-talk is hidden under 'More' (screen 1), but faculty who talk into rooms need room or simulator audio one tap away.
mobbin:06bcb061-a16d-4a6f-95bd-8c5e31c5f.fit: Recording: a model for talking into the room or as the voice of the manikin from beside the SRV, with a hold-to-talk button that clearly shows when you are live.

mobbin:5a85acae-251f-4a89-8b61-20b3dc15a.summary: From Slack's workflow templates, the user sets up a daily standup message at a fixed time, can't publish until a recipient is chosen, and saves the message after previewing it.
steps: Message step with channel and preview
Workflow with the message step completed
steal: Templates are grouped by what starts them, such as 'Scheduled date & time' (screen 1), so operators pick a trigger instead of starting from scratch.
A step with no recipient is marked pink with 'Needs attention' and can't be saved (screens 2 to 3), so an announcement with no target can't go out.
Both the trigger and each following step have an 'Edit' link (screens 2 and 5), so the user can change the time or target without starting over.
A preview before 'Publish' shows the exact wording that will be played in the room (screens 4 to 5).
avoid: A general workflow builder with many steps is too much for a single scheduled room message, compared with a simple form for time, target and message.
mobbin:5a85acae-251f-4a89-8b61-20b3dc15a.fit: Recording: useful for scheduled announcements, the 5 am self-test and automatic recording outside the SRV. Each needs a time, a required target and a preview.
